title: Diver visual census counts of 158 reef fish taxa on 14 artificial and natural reefs, eastern Gulf of Mexico, quarterly 2013-2023 (without IUCN-threatened taxa, coordinates as published)
creator: Stallings, Christopher D.; Emory, Meaghan E.; Peake, Jonathan A.; Schram, Michael J.; Wall, Kara R.; Williams, Ian
citation: Stallings, C. D., Emory, M. E., Peake, J. A., Schram, M. J., Wall, K. R. & Williams, I. (2025). Ten years (2013-2023) of fish assemblage data collected seasonally with diver surveys on artificial and natural reefs. Ecology 106(5), e70108. https://doi.org/10.1002/ecy.70108. Data: Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14338634 (CC BY 4.0).
abstract: Stationary-point underwater visual census of reef fish on eight paired artificial and natural reefs (2013-2023) and six further artificial reefs (2020-2023) off west-central Florida. Each calendar quarter two divers made two to four 10-minute counts of every fish seen in a cylinder of up to 7.5 m radius (visibility-limited); 1,349 counts, 544,736 fish, 171 resolved taxa. This table omits the 13 IUCN CR/EN/VU taxa so that reef coordinates and names ship as published; stallings_2025_gulfreefs_count has all 171 with coarsened coordinates.
samplingProtocol: Stationary-point visual census by SCUBA divers: 10-minute counts of all fishes within an imaginary cylinder of radius up to 7.5 m (horizontal visibility) from the seafloor to the surface; two to four counts per reef per calendar quarter, usually two divers each making two counts; lengths estimated per fish or per school.
surveyEvidenceNote: surveys.csv lists all 1,349 counts; every fishes.csv row belongs to a listed count, so a taxon absent from a count's rows is a zero. The 17 codes missing from taxa.csv (larvae, bait fish, unknowns, unresolved family / genus codes; 183 rows) are dropped as taxa, not as surveys.
closureNote: occasion within period (the two to four counts of one reef in one quarter, made within minutes or a few days by side-by-side divers; the authors warn that within-survey sample units are not independent); open between quarters

geographicCoverage.description: Artificial and natural reefs 8-30 m deep off Pinellas and Manatee counties, west-central Florida, eastern Gulf of Mexico, USA

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published (3 decimals): the 13 IUCN CR/EN/VU taxa are not in this table (E7.3)

notShipped.IUCN CR/EN/VU taxa: BACA, BACE, CALE, CALI, CAPL, EPIT, EPMO, GICI, LAMA, LUCA, LUCY, MYMI, RHAU: in stallings_2025_gulfreefs_count only, whose coordinates are coarsened
notShipped.fishes.csv size, school_mean_size, schoo: individual and school length estimates (biomass is rebuildable from the deposit with taxa.csv's length-weight coefficients)
notShipped.surveys.csv time_start, time_stop: clock times, several clearly mistyped; every count is 10 minutes
notShipped.17 species codes absent from taxa.csv: GOFM, LARV, UNKN, HOSP, CLFM, SCPP, LUSP, LAFM, BAIT, TEFM, CALF, OPSP, OSFM, GYSP, SPPP, CAFM, EPSP: 183 rows, 164050 fish (larval fish, bait fish, unknowns, and family / genus codes the deposit does not define)
notShipped.AC5_FA16_1 ARPR second row: no number and no length beside a real row: an empty duplicate
